description: Multi-endpoint co-primary trial design with multiplicity control. Use when a confirmatory trial requires positive results on two or more primary endpoints (oncology PFS+OS, CV death+HHF, etc.). Strategies: fixed-sequence (hierarchical, full alpha per test, the canonical approach for ordered co-primary), alpha-split (partition alpha by weights), bonferroni (equal alpha-split). Each endpoint is sized at its effective alpha via the matching design_<type> wrapper; total N is the max across endpoints. For graphical multiplicity (Maurer-Bretz with alpha recycling), use `design_graphical_multiplicity` instead.

allocation_ratio.description: Treatment-to-control allocation ratio, shared across endpoints.

alpha_weights.description: For strategy='alpha-split' only. Named numeric vector summing to 1. Default (when omitted with alpha-split): equal weights 1/k.

type.description: Endpoint family — selects which design_<type> wrapper handles this endpoint.

endpoints.description: Named map of co-primary endpoints. Each entry has `type` plus the parameters the matching design_<type> wrapper accepts (e.g., for survival: model, design_class, control_median, hazard_ratio, accrual_duration, followup_duration).

ordering.description: For strategy='fixed-sequence' only. Endpoint names in test order. Default: order in which `endpoints` was supplied.

reasoning_chain.description: Optional structured citation trail. Each entry: {decision, value, justification, source_type, source_ref?}. design_report() renders this inline; sponsor_confidential entries trigger a redaction prompt.

items.description: One reasoning-chain entry — a single design decision with its provenance. The LLM and user fill the content; the package validates the shape.

decision.description: Short label for the design choice (e.g., 'alpha', 'hazard_ratio').

justification.description: One sentence explaining why this value was chosen.

source_ref.description: Free-text reference (citation, NCT id, internal protocol number). Optional but encouraged for non-default entries.

source_type.description: Provenance tag for a reasoning-chain entry. Drives the design_report redaction prompt (sponsor_confidential entries flagged before sharing).

value.description: The chosen value (numeric, string, or boolean).

strategy.description: Multiplicity-control strategy. `fixed-sequence` (hierarchical) tests each endpoint at the full family alpha conditional on prior rejection — preserves alpha by closed testing, no per-test discount. `alpha-split` partitions alpha by user weights. `bonferroni` is equal-weight alpha-split (alpha/k).

name: design_co_primary
